title: Heap-based buffer overflow in Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, and ACM70XX firmware versions 4.8.0 through 5.5.2 on console…
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, and ACM70XX console server appliances running firmware versions 4.8.0 through 5.5.2. This flaw can be triggered by an unauthenticated remote attacker sending a specially crafted multipart/form-data POST request with an excessively long Content-Disposition name field, causing the index.cgi process to crash.
